name: hospital-management-system
description: MERN Stack Hospital Management System - patients, doctors, scheduling, clinical records, billing, reporting and audit.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
